title: Noise preprocessing and tester acceptance
statement: Let $T$ be a sign tester, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube taking values in $[-1,1]$. The acceptance probability of $T$ after independently applying noise with correlation $1-\delta$ to each check's queries equals the acceptance probability of $T$ on the function obtained by applying the noise operator with correlation $1-\delta$ to $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a sign tester on the $n$-dimensional sign cube with finite seed space
